dedupe_keys.name: quantifying flood exposure for pakistan s 2022 floods from remotely sensed data

description: Rafael Jan Pablo Schmitt at Stanford University publishes a workflow for estimating flood depth from remotely sensed information during Pakistan's 2022 floods. Zenodo lists MATLAB scripts for flood analysis and flood-stage extraction, together with an InputsOutputs archive. The April 2023 deposit is available free under CC BY 4.0. Its stated purpose is rapid assessment for reconstruction and adaptation across sectors. The page identifies the national event context but does not specify the mapped extent, spatial resolution, acquisition dates or validation accuracy. Those coverage details remain unknown. Estimated depths could inform infrastructure exposure and flood-damage simulations once the input assumptions and scripts are checked. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The metadata establish reusable code and accompanying data, but neither the archive contents nor the numerical workflow were executed.
